Olivia's Prime Steakhouse (Da Nang, Vietnam)
Aug 2026 • Family
On a scale of 1 to 5, I rate restaurants from a personal perspective.

【Location】3
I feel like it doesn’t really matter everywhere because I move with grab.

【Atmosphere】4
When I was inside, I couldn't tell if it was Da Nang or New York. The atmosphere is not bad.

【Cooking】4
It was quite expensive, but the taste was good. There are various sets, so I think you can ask them to add them.

【Customer service】3
I'm glad that many of you are fluent in English.

【Price Performance】2
I think the good thing about Da Nang food is that CP is very good. CP is not good in that sense, but I think it's a good deal by Japanese standards, but it's a pretty good price ...

【General】4
The price is wildly high in the Da Nang sense, but I think it is good to eat very reasonable meat in the Japanese sense. The shop itself looks good, so it might be a good idea to use it as an anniversary. If you are willing to pay a high price, I think you will be happy to go.

Amazing Birthday Dinner and Exceptional Service!
Aug 2026 • Couples
We celebrated my husband’s birthday at Olivia’s Steakhouse, and it was such a wonderful experience! The food was delicious, and the service was excellent.

Our waitress, Mai, was incredibly attentive, and Thuy, another server, made us feel so welcome. They both went above and beyond to make my husband’s birthday feel special. They sang “Happy Birthday” and surprised him with a dessert to celebrate.

And Thuy didn’t stop there. She brought us not one, but TWO chocolate vodka shots! They were absolutely delicious and such a fun addition to the celebration.

If you’re looking for a place to enjoy a great dinner and celebrate a special occasion, Olivia’s Steakhouse is the place to go. Be sure to ask for Mai or Thuy. They truly made our evening memorable!

May 2026 • Family
We had a wonderful dining experience at Olivia’s Prime Steakhouse. The Classic Seared Scallops, Baguette Plate, and Spaghetti Aglio Olio with Burrata Cheese were all beautifully prepared and full of flavor. The fresh Mango Juice was equally enjoyable and complemented the meal perfectly. Every dish reflected the quality and attention to detail you’d expect from a premium dining establishment.

A special mention to our server My and her team, who were exceptionally courteous, attentive, and professional throughout our visit. Their warm hospitality made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived, and they were always available whenever we needed assistance. The complimentary shots served at the end were a thoughtful touch that made the experience even more memorable.

Overall, an excellent combination of great food, premium ambiance, and outstanding service. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a quality dining experience in Da Nang.
